answer: The pulse chain is verified at intake and dawn publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 13 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 13 epochs old, anchored at a quill checkpoint. That bill is paid per identity, so 164 aliases cost 85 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
